definitions.explanation: describes a melancholy atmosphere or feeling of isolation

examples.japanese: {侘|わび}しい⟦{一人暮|ひとりぐ}らし→一人暮らし：03142_hitorigurashi⟧。
⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夕暮|ゆうぐ}れ→夕暮れ：07682_yuugure⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{侘|わび}しい。
⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{泊|と}まる→泊まる：10445_tomaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{侘|わび}しい{気持|きも}ち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Staying alone at an old inn makes me feel forlorn.

notes:
USAGE:
- {侘|わび}しい⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧ (dreary life)
- {侘|わび}しい{気持|きも}ち (lonely feeling)
- {侘|わび}しい⟦{風景|ふうけい}→風景：03591_fuukei⟧ (desolate scenery)
Conveys a poetic, wistful loneliness rather than simple isolation. Often evokes imagery of autumn or winter, empty spaces, or solitary living.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Related to the aesthetic concept of ⟦{侘|わ}び→侘び：10655_wabi⟧ (wabi) - finding beauty in simplicity and imperfection, though the adjective emphasizes the melancholy aspect more than the aesthetic appreciation.

FORMS:
- Adverb: {侘|わび}しく
- Noun form: {侘|わび}しさ (loneliness, dreariness)
